blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) inspected 65 establishments selling vape products during its nationwide Tax Compliance Verification Drive (TCVD) on October 7, 2026, as part of its intensified campaign against illicitvapor products and tax violations. The operations covered five revenue regions: Cagayan Valley, Central Luzon, LaQueMar (Laguna, Quezon, Marinduque), the Negros Island Region, and Cagayan de Oro City, resulting in the issuance of 18 apprehension slips and the documentation of 19 violations. BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza said the coordinated drive underscores the bureau’s commitment to protecting government revenues, ensuring fair competition, and holding businesses accountable […]...
